articles.title: Z+ (abopflichtiger Inhalt); Mondmission Artemis 2: Was von der Mondumrundung bleibt
articles.teaser: Das war's mit täglichen Fotos und Videos, kleinen Storys und großem Staunen aus dem All. Artemis 2 ist vorüber. Aber an diese zehn Dinge werden wir uns erinnern.
articles.image_title: Mondmission Artemis 2: art002e010208 (April 6, 2026) - As the Artemis II crew flew over the terminator, the astronauts described this boundary between day and night as "anything but a straight line." Crater rims along the terminator stand out as "islands" in the night. Giant chains of craters emanating from the 3.7-billion-year-old Orientale basin can be seen scouring the surface, stretching almost to the terminator. This tells a geologic story: these crater chains produced by the Orientale impact event mar the surface of the relatively flat Hertzsprung Basin (center of this image), which means that Hertzsprung Basin must be even older than Orientale!

articles.image_title: Schnapsbrennen: Providence - January 12: Head Distiller Dan Neff holds a handful of malted corn, an ingredient in their vodka, in the distillery in Providence, RI on Jan. 12, 2022. The Industrious Spirit Company (ISCO) is Providence's first-ever distillery since Prohibition. And this boutique distillery, founded by CEO Manya K. Rubinstein, is making the world's first-ever oyster-distilled vodka. Ostreida Vodka starts as regionally-grown, organic, non-GMO corn. ISCO ferments and distills the corn in small batches and it is then combined with local oysters for the last distillation. A portion of the proceeds are going to GreenWave, an organization that trains and supports ocean farmers in the era of climate change by working with coastal communities to create a blue economy. articles.title: Z+ (abopflichtiger Inhalt); CO₂-Abscheidung im Hamburger Hafen: "Ohne uns wird die Stadt ihre Klimaziele nicht erreichen"
articles.teaser: 2040 soll Hamburg klimaneutral sein. Dabei stoßen allein Müllverbrennungsanlagen Hunderttausende Tonnen CO₂ pro Jahr aus. Eine neue Technik könnte das Problem lindern.
articles.image_title: CO₂-Abscheidung im Hamburger Hafen: Eine Herausforderung für Hamburgs Klimastrategie: Schornsteine einer Müllverbrennungsanlage im Stadtteil Billbrook. Die Stadtreinigung ist als Betreiber solcher Anlagen einer der größten Emittenten von Treibhausgasen in Hamburg.
